_comment: Seeded 2026-09-23: every correction/feedback email already in the queue was read by hand when config/standing_notes.txt was written, so none is re-proposed.

proposed.note: When reporting on Cariboo Regional District elections, note which areas have no vote due to acclamation and which have contested races.
When a candidate withdraws from an election, verify the withdrawal against the source's reporting rather than assuming it is unconfirmed.
Before saying a candidate has no public record, check local news outlets for background information such as prior service or first-time candidate status.
Verify facts about dates and deadlines carefully, especially when multiple dates appear in the same story segment, as these are easily corrected mistakes that should not occur.
